audit.whatIsWrong: All seven full-layer sides disagreed with content win[] and the packet levelChart, three content whys[] argued against their own row, and the page was rated TRICKY 7/10 against a 51.14% win rate.
audit.why: Diana's Q is 900 against Ice Shard at 725 and Ring of Frost only reaches 450, so levels 1-2 are hers. From 3 the Glacial Path claw into Ring of Frost is a real trade and Ice Shard falls to 4s at rank 4. Level 6 goes back to Diana: Moonfall is 100s against Frozen Tomb's 120s. From first item the self-cast Tomb and the CC chain scale past single-target burst. 51.14% over 2,671 games is an even lane, not a 7/10.
audit.corrected: Full-layer sides moved onto the content chart, all seven whys rewritten to match their rows, whys[2], whys[3] and whys[4] corrected, and diff/diffRating/tone moved to EVEN 5.5/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes named no numbers and spikes[1].text used the placeholder phrase 'her Moonfall-equivalent all-in'.
audit.why: The level 6 comparison is concrete: Moonfall 100/90/80 against Frozen Tomb 120/100/80. Glacial Path's 24s at rank 1 is the other spike that matters.
audit.corrected: Both spikes written with the real cooldowns and the placeholder phrase removed.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page called Glacial Path a stun (content mid and spikes[1].text — the packet flagged it), swapped E and W in wants.foe[0], and never mentioned that Frozen Tomb can be self-cast.
audit.why: Glacial Path is a 1050-range claw she re-activates to teleport to; it has no CC. The stun is Frozen Tomb (550 range, 120/100/80) and Riot's text says cast on herself she is 'healing herself while becoming untargetable and invulnerable'. The root is Ring of Frost at 450, 10s at rank 1. That self-cast is what makes an all-in that fails to kill worthless, and it is the anti-heal case.
audit.corrected: Stun attributed to Frozen Tomb everywhere, E/W corrected in wants.foe[0], and the untargetable self-cast stated in the don't, in early and in phases[5].why.

audit.why: Glacial Path 24/21/18/15/12, Ring of Frost 10-8, Ice Shard 7/6/5/4/3, Frozen Tomb 120/100/80, Pale Cascade 15 at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal timing despite Frozen Tomb healing her through the trade you commit to.
audit.why: Riot text on the self-cast: healing herself while untargetable and invulnerable.

edits.before: Level 1-2 Lissandra has no self-root combo yet, so poke freely with Q and avoid overextending. The moment she hits 3 and has E-W online, her root-into-claw trade starts threatening real damage and you should stop trading blade for blade. She has a genuine self-peel tool built in, so all-ins that don't burst her instantly just let her walk away unpunished.
edits.after: Level 1-2 Lissandra has only Ice Shard at 725 range, so poke freely from 900 and avoid overextending. The moment she hits 3 and has Glacial Path into Ring of Frost online, her claw-into-root trade threatens real damage and you should stop trading blade for blade. Her self-cast Frozen Tomb heals and goes untargetable, so an all-in that does not kill just lets her walk away.

edits.before: Her Glacial Path stun combined with her ultimate lockdown at 6 makes her all-in stronger than yours in a vacuum — she can root-stun-claw before you land your own combo. Avoid isolated skirmishes near her flank range and instead look to pick her off with jungle assistance when she's out of resource. Ban or track her R cooldown closely since it both saves her and sets up ally kills.
edits.after: Ring of Frost roots at 450 and Frozen Tomb stuns at 550 — Glacial Path is the 1050-range claw she engages and escapes on, not a stun. Avoid isolated skirmishes inside that claw range and pick her off with jungle help when it is down for 24 seconds. Track Frozen Tomb closely: at 120 seconds it both saves her untargetable and sets up ally kills.
